$comment: Fields that must survive the client -> control plane -> engine round trip. Every seam on that path rebuilds its payload from a hand-written allow-list, so a field can be declared at one end, sent faithfully, and vanish in the middle with nothing failing and nothing logged. Twice in one day on 2026-08-17: `sourceRefs` died in the front end's bootstrap options, `retrieval_text` in the control plane's payload builder. Adding a field here makes every seam's contract test fail until that seam forwards it.

request.$comment: Client -> engine. `required_forward` fields must be forwarded by every intermediary that builds an engine payload.

consumed_before_handler.$comment: Declared so every seam forwards them, but NOT read by `handlers/query.py` — they are addressing rather than question. Listing them here is what keeps the engine guard's 'is this field actually read' check honest: the alternative was an `if field == ...` skip in test code, which is a place a second exception gets added without anyone deciding to.
consumed_before_handler.dataset_id: picks which database the request runs against; resolved on the way in, never by the query handler
consumed_before_handler.resource_id: the UMA resource a grantee turn is aimed at; the control plane validates the grant from it and the node carries it for provenance

notes.query: the owner's own words — planner window, vector ranking and the scope classifier all need a sentence
notes.retrieval_text: the SUBJECT, for rare-gate needles only; never a replacement for `query`
notes.retrieval_parts: the SAME needles, one entry per section of a multi-part request, in request order. The rare gate runs once per entry and vetoes only when every entry is unanswerable, so one section's specific ask cannot empty another section's lane. Absent means one part and is byte-identical to before. Needles only — `query` stays the owner's sentence.
notes.now: caller-local ISO instant so relative dates resolve against the owner's calendar day

response.$comment: Engine -> client. `required_return` fields must survive every normalisation step on the way back, including the front end's own. Each repo drives its own return-path guard off THIS list — a literal spelled in a test file can never fail when the list grows, which is how `deny_reason` sat declared and uncovered in all three repos while the engine's manifest-denial path dropped it on every real denial.

originates.$comment: Which field is emitted by the ENGINE and which is echoed by the transport. Both must survive every seam — that is what `required_return` means — but only the engine-originated ones can be asserted on an engine payload. Recorded here rather than skipped in test code, for the same reason `consumed_before_handler` is: an exemption argued in the protocol is one somebody decided, and the next one has to be argued too.
originates.scope_id: transport — the engine answers inside a scope it was told; the control plane echoes it from the request it routed
originates.access_mode: transport — the disclosure tier is the caller's; the control plane echoes it back beside the answer

deny_reason_location.$comment: Canonical location of `deny_reason` on an engine payload: TOP LEVEL. Every denial the pipeline returns puts it there (`pipeline.py` — session mismatch, empty query, negotiation exhausted, mode ceiling, classifier, retrieval error) and so does the handler's manifest-validation denial. `audit.deny_reason` is a secondary copy written by `build_query_audit_event`, and it is absent entirely on the manifest-validation path — a seam that recovers the reason ONLY from the audit block drops it on exactly the denial the owner is most likely to hit.

notes.narrowing: the ledger: what each stage removed and why. Two return-path allow-lists would have swallowed it silently.
notes.deny_reason: why the turn was refused. A denial without it is the opacity this redesign exists to end: an ungranted scope reads exactly like a scope with no data.
notes.public_result.empty_cause: which of five reasons a lane came back empty; carried inside public_result so it reaches synthesis
